limits: Canvas2D component diagnostic only; not full game, WebGL2, boot, package loader, WeChat or device acceptance.
Direct Canvas2D backdrop-then-UI composition; does not verify the production GPU texture compositing/color/blending path.
Fixed CSS viewports at DPR 1; no user-agent, hardware, touch-device or WeChat safe-area emulation.
Seeded isolated in-memory Save (seed 1, 1200 points); no real player storage is accessed.
Loading/loading-failed use controlled createOpening loader fixtures. Retry validates renderer hit geometry and fixture transition only.
All runtime art and fonts must pass byte-size/SHA-256 and real browser decode/registration before visual readiness.
No audio or world simulation. Battle-state transitions expose only CanvasUI HUD and are marked outside scope.
Any requested 3D/showcase preview layer is not rendered and blocks visual readiness; home uses its actual registered static foreground.
The node-only package auto-loader is an unreachable QA compile-time guard; real page entry registration is explicit.
No comparison score, page design acceptance or visual pass is established by this build or Node tests.
compileTimeProjection: runtime-manifest visuals/file only; guard unreachable node-entries
